notes: California 1997-2001 (EV, Jackal, Stone, Special), Quota 1100 ES, V11 Sport and LeMans up to 2002. Open loop - no lambda sensor on most images, so there is no closed-loop trim to read. The TPS is set mechanically with a voltmeter; there is no electronic reset. Live local identifiers for this family have not been captured yet. Run the read-only identifier discovery scan and contribute the result; until then the workstation offers identification, DTCs and raw discovery only.
